title: Amethyst Ender
description: A mod adding strong amethyst items and superpowered enderite items
body:
This mod is my take on upgrading amethyst as a material and adding a strong material in the end. These items can be made into amazing armor and tools making you almost invincible. With just one amethyst tool/armor, one netherite tool/armor, one pit stop to the sculk dimension, and a few refined enderite, you can become the strongest being in the overworld. Experience thrilling powers with your sword and boots as you conquer the overworld. This mod is still being developed so stay tuned for more versions to come
